items.title: Michael Abene interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: it’s Don Sebesky and I and Willie Maiden did the writing.

ctx.x: That was right after that. There was so many fox numbers in, I can think of “Fox Hunt,” and there was all this fox thing going, seeping through the band over the years, you know, “Three Little Foxes,” “Three Little Foxes,” “Fox Hunt,” more foxes, less foxes, red foxes.
Willie Maiden? Was he in the band then?

Yeah. Willie was there forever I think. He was there forever. And he went on to — he became basically I saw the straw boss of Kenton’s band for a while. And it was a good scene. It was a very good scene.
